articles.title: Bitcoin traders eye post-election rally as exchange outflows point to supply squeeze
articles.snippet: Bulls are watching short positions, exchange withdrawals and key price levels for signs of a rebound after the midterms.

articles.title: NYSE tokenized stock plans take shape as four more transfer agents join
articles.snippet: Broadridge, Computershare, Equiniti and Superstate join the exchange's planned blockchain market, bringing shareholder records and voting services onchain.

articles.title: XRP Ledger set to fix flaw that could have let stablecoin partners print new tokens
articles.snippet: The fix is on track for Wednesday after validator support briefly dipped and restarted the two-week activation clock. XRP itself is unaffected.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin bounce fades as Binance exploit, AI unwind continue to weigh
articles.snippet: The Nasdaq flipped from a 1% gain to a 1% decline on Monday even as interest rates pulled back and oil plunged on hopes for Middle East peace.

articles.title: China’s Communist Party calls for a crackdown on corruption that uses crypto and blockchain
articles.snippet: China's Communist Party has named virtual currency and blockchain in a new anti-corruption call.
